SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is a gallery walk? (1 mark)
   A. Walking round to look at displayed work
   B. A kind of assembly
   C. A cooking lesson
   D. A race

2. In a chart of who gives and who needs, what does a nurse give? (1 mark)
   A. Health care
   B. Food
   C. Transport
   D. Learning

3. Being good even when nobody is watching is called what? (1 mark)
   A. Punishment
   B. Fashion
   C. Integrity
   D. Boasting

4. Which lake is the largest lake in Africa and is shared by Kenya, Uganda and Tanzania? (1 mark)
   A. Lake Nakuru
   B. Lake Baringo
   C. Lake Victoria
   D. Lake Naivasha

5. County X covers 8 grid squares and County Y covers 5 grid squares. Which statement is correct? (1 mark)
   A. County Y is bigger than County X
   B. We cannot compare them
   C. They are the same size
   D. County X is bigger than County Y

6. Who is the head of a county government? (1 mark)
   A. The Speaker
   B. The MCA
   C. The Governor
   D. The chief

7. Which is a way of conserving water? (1 mark)
   A. Polluting rivers
   B. Leaving taps running
   C. Turning off taps after use
   D. Cutting trees near rivers

8. Which place is used mainly for prayers and worship? (1 mark)
   A. Church, mosque or temple
   B. Hospital
   C. Market
   D. Factory

9. Why should voting be secret? (1 mark)
   A. So that the winner is hidden
   B. So that nobody can force how you vote
   C. So that nobody counts
   D. So that votes are lost

10. What is campaigning? (1 mark)
   A. Announcing results
   B. Telling voters why they should choose you
   C. Counting votes
   D. Throwing away ballots

11. What is discipline? (1 mark)
   A. Running away
   B. Shouting
   C. Doing what you like
   D. Controlling yourself and following rules

12. Who leads the meetings of the county assembly? (1 mark)
   A. The Speaker
   B. The governor
   C. The driver
   D. The chief

13. Which of these spoils peace? (1 mark)
   A. Listening
   B. Forgiveness
   C. Bullying
   D. Fairness

14. Who is a good resource person to learn about community leadership? (1 mark)
   A. A cartoon
   B. A village elder
   C. A stranger who knows nothing
   D. A random shop

15. Which of these is a trusted adult? (1 mark)
   A. A person who threatens you
   B. A stranger you met online
   C. A parent or teacher
   D. A person who gives you sweets in secret

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Describe how you would draw a sketch map of your county in five steps. (5 marks)

17. Who is a clan elder? (2 marks)

18. Describe four things a school can do to promote child rights. (4 marks)

19. What is the difference between a lake and a river? (2 marks)

20. Name two water features found in Kenya. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Walking round to look at displayed work
   In a gallery walk pupils look at each other's displays.

2. A — Health care
   Nurses give health care.

3. C — Integrity
   Integrity means doing right when unseen.

4. C — Lake Victoria
   Lake Victoria is shared by three countries.

5. D — County X is bigger than County Y
   8 squares is more land than 5 squares.

6. C — The Governor
   The governor leads the county.

7. C — Turning off taps after use
   Saving water helps everyone.

8. A — Church, mosque or temple
   Places of worship are for prayer.

9. B — So that nobody can force how you vote
   Secret voting protects free choice.

10. B — Telling voters why they should choose you
   Candidates campaign before elections.

11. D — Controlling yourself and following rules
   Discipline is self-control and obeying rules.

12. A — The Speaker
   The Speaker leads the assembly.

13. C — Bullying
   Bullying hurts and frightens people.

14. B — A village elder
   A village elder knows leadership.

15. C — A parent or teacher
   Trusted adults protect children.

SECTION B
----
16. (5 marks)
   Answer: Draw the county outline. Draw the sub-county boundaries. Write the names of the sub-counties. Show the neighbouring counties around the edge. Add a north arrow, a title and a key, then colour it.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct step.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: A clan elder is an older respected member of a clan who leads it and keeps its customs.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for respected older member, 1 mark for leading or keeping customs.

18. (4 marks)
   Answer: Make posters, sing songs on child protection, set up a suggestion box, and include all children in activities.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each activity.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: A lake is a large area of water with land around it. A river is water flowing along a channel to a lake or ocean.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct description.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: Lake Victoria and the Tana River. Accept Lake Turkana, Lake Naivasha or the Indian Ocean.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct feature.
